interpretation: Transcript-level comparison within the same indication. Stromal/myeloid cells exceed malignant/epithelial cell CD276 in both LUAD and SCLC. This is a transcript-level caveat and a potential stromal antigen sink; it is not a measure of tumour-cell surface protein and is not evidence against an ADC.
